calls.title: Rob and James Shannon
calls.summary: The team discussed adopting an experiment-based pricing model for large accounts, recognizing the challenges of fluctuating user numbers under seat-based pricing. Proposed pricing ranges from $150 to $300 per experiment, with discounts for higher volumes, and annual billing suggested for better management. Support strategies were also a focus, with the introduction of a UK-based GrowthBook team to improve regional support and a clear escalation path for customer issues. Additionally, insights from customer feedback highlighted GrowthBook's appeal due to its cost-effectiveness and cookie-less experimentation capabilities, which fostered high satisfaction and engagement. The meeting emphasized leveraging AI tools to streamline processes and boost Future GrowthBook adoption.
calls.keywords: experiment-based pricing, GrowthBook, feature flags, AI automation, Pro vs Enterprise plans, customer support
